name: Neopress Open Graph brand card by Neopress
description: A maximum-restraint social card: a warm cream canvas (roughly #FAF7F0, deliberately not pure white) with a single black lockup dead-centre on both axes. The lockup pairs a thick geometric mark — a rounded-diamond outline whose stroke pinches at the four vertices around a white core — with 'Neopress' set in a bold, high-contrast editorial serif with tight tracking; the icon's height is matched to the cap height so the two read as one unit occupying about a third of the canvas width. There is no headline, URL or imagery: hierarchy, scale contrast (huge ink shapes vs ~25% margins of empty paper) and the serif-on-paper tone do all the work. A stray red pixel in the top-left corner reads as a capture artefact rather than part of the design.
